title: TWO ISKANDERS
POLAND AND LATVIA
yt_title: What If Russia Hit Poland and Latvia With Iskander Missiles? #shorts
hook: A simulation: one Iskander hits Malbork Air Base in Poland, then half an hour later a second hits Adazi Base in Latvia, each in about three and a half minutes.

title: ONE 10 KT NUKE
OVER THE BALTIC
yt_title: What If a 10 Kiloton Nuke Hit Over the Baltic Sea? #shorts
hook: A simulation: a 10 kiloton warhead has burst over open water, and the rings run from the fireball to the ring that flattens most buildings.

title: ONE NUCLEAR ISKANDER
OUT OF KALININGRAD
yt_title: What If Russia Fired One Nuke From Kaliningrad? #shorts
hook: A simulation: one dual-capable Iskander leaves Kaliningrad with a nuclear warhead aimed at open sea, a warning shot, in three and a half minutes.
